subject.title: feat: keep reset session history searchable

question: Should explicit `/reset` and `/new` retain historical SQLite generations by default, with physical disk pressure as the only automatic reclamation boundary?
rationale: This is a persistent user-data and upgrade-policy change rather than a mechanical correction; the merged automatic-reset default change does not by itself establish this separate retention contract.

options.title: Sponsor retained history
options.body: Accept durable reset history as the product policy, provided the store-ownership bug is fixed and upgrade/runtime proof is added.

options.title: Keep reset archival semantics
options.body: Preserve the current reset-to-archive behavior and narrow the work to any independently approved disk-budget improvements.

recommendation.title: Sponsor retained history
recommendation.body: Accept durable reset history as the product policy, provided the store-ownership bug is fixed and upgrade/runtime proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged reset-policy work and this PR's proposed retention model.
